reviewer.note: Round 2 review at 99aff0a3 (PR #447), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 2. As hay_19 (same build): 14 tones, one-tone top region 336 texels, ruled 1-texel straw, flat east end; bar 0.75 -> 0.55. Fix list: XR2-H1 to XR2-H4.
fix_list: XR2-H1: give the bale volume: round the top-front and top-east edges over 2-3 rows (a lit band of tone 5 at the top-front arris, falling to tone 3 on the front), and knock each corner off 2 steps, as the Eastward 17 bale

XR2-H2: straw as strand clusters, not ruled 1-texel dashes: 2-3 texel tufts in 3-4 tones of the straw ramp, running along the bale on the top and across the cut ends, with a few strands breaking the silhouette
XR2-H3: the east end as a cut face with its own texture (dark tufts, a core shadow) instead of a flat mauve rectangle, and the front in horizontal bands of 3-4 tones in 2-3 px clusters
XR2-H4: twine pressed in: a dark line with a lit lip 1 texel off it, sinking into the straw and turning over the top-front edge
